question: Sandeep starts walking towards the north from a point and walks 30 m. He turns to the right and walks 30 m. He turns to the left and walks 20 m. He turns to the left and walks 30 m. Finally, he turns to the left and walks 30 m. How far is he now from the starting point? (AlI turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given**:

Sandeep starts walking towards the north from a point and walks 30 m.

He turns to the right and walks 30 m.

He turns to the left and walks 20 m.

He turns to the left and walks 30 m.

Finally, he turns to the left and walks 30 m.

Based on the given conditions, we get the direction distance diagram as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8d4407cf5039b0574eb0697d11228b077d7c7180ea3bdfecdbfa925ccfc41c.png] 

Therefore, we see that he is 20 m away from his starting point at present. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
